description: Permissions for the game and editor windows (both use the label "main") and the editor's Projects window ("projects", ADR 0059), which shows and hides itself and the editor window. Storage (ADR 0024) reads and writes the app data folder. The editor (ADR 0026) reads and writes project folders the user picks: fs:read-all and fs:write-all enable the commands without any fixed paths, and the dialog plugin adds each picked folder to the fs scope for the session. the borderless Projects window drags, minimises, closes and sizes itself to its panel (core:window:allow-start-dragging, -minimize, -close, -set-size, -set-position, -center; the monitor, scale and position reads are in core:default). core:webview:allow-create-webview-window lets the Projects window create the editor window once it has shown (ADR 0082). core:window:allow-destroy lets the editor's unsaved-changes guard close the window after asking. fs:allow-watch / fs:allow-unwatch let the editor reload scripts edited outside it, and opener:allow-open-path opens a script in the system's code editor (ADR 0030), opener:allow-reveal-item-in-dir shows an asset in the file manager, and opener:allow-open-url opens the guide (Help > Documentation) in the browser.
